provenance: Project-authored deterministic synthetic API, commerce, parsing and documentation utility repair tasks. Acceptance checks and control patches are not sent to the model. Narrow stdlib Python benchmark, not professional whole-repository capability evidence.

tasks.goal: Implement normalize_headers(headers). Normalize HTTP request header keys to lowercase and strip surrounding spaces from string values. Return a new mapping.
tasks.control_patch:
def normalize_headers(headers):
    return {k.lower():v.strip() for k,v in headers.items()}

tasks.goal: Implement retryable_status(status). Return True only for HTTP status 408, 429, 500, 502, 503 or 504.
tasks.acceptance: assert retryable_status(503) is True and retryable_status(404) is False and retryable_status(429) is True
tasks.control_patch:
def retryable_status(status):
    return status in {408,429,500,502,503,504}

tasks.goal: Implement page_offset(page,size). Return pagination offset for a one-based page; clamp page numbers below one to one.
tasks.control_patch:
def page_offset(page,size):
    return (max(1,page)-1)*size

tasks.goal: Implement bearer_token(header). Extract a Bearer token from an Authorization header, case insensitive. Return None for a different scheme or missing token.
tasks.acceptance: assert bearer_token('bearer abc')=='abc' and bearer_token('Basic abc') is None and bearer_token('Bearer') is None

tasks.goal: Implement redact_credentials(record). Return a copied mapping with values for password, token or api_key keys (case insensitive) replaced with [REDACTED]. Keep other fields.
tasks.control_patch:
def redact_credentials(record):
    return {k:('[REDACTED]' if k.lower() in {'password','token','api_key'} else v) for k,v in record.items()}

tasks.goal: Implement cart_subtotal(items). Compute WooCommerce cart subtotal in integer cents from each item price_cents multiplied by quantity. Empty cart returns zero.
tasks.control_patch:
def cart_subtotal(items):
    return sum(x['price_cents']*x['quantity'] for x in items)

tasks.goal: Implement discount_cents(amount,percent). Apply an integer percent discount to nonnegative cents, clamp percent to 0..100 and round downward to cents.
tasks.acceptance: assert discount_cents(999,10)==899 and discount_cents(500,150)==0 and discount_cents(500,-5)==500
tasks.control_patch:
def discount_cents(amount,percent):
    return amount*(100-max(0,min(100,percent)))//100

tasks.goal: Implement stock_status(quantity). Return WooCommerce stock status instock for positive quantity, otherwise outofstock.
tasks.control_patch:
def stock_status(quantity):
    return 'instock' if quantity>0 else 'outofstock'

tasks.goal: Implement wordpress_slug(title). Create a lowercase ASCII WordPress-style slug: replace runs of non a-z/0-9 characters with one hyphen, strip edge hyphens.
tasks.acceptance: assert wordpress_slug(' Hello, World! ')== 'hello-world' and wordpress_slug('A---B')=='a-b'

tasks.goal: Implement shopify_gid(resource,number). Build a Shopify global ID gid://shopify/<resource>/<number>.
tasks.control_patch:
def shopify_gid(resource,number):
    return f'gid://shopify/{resource}/{number}'

tasks.goal: Implement product_id_from_gid(gid). Parse numeric product ID from gid://shopify/Product/<digits>; return None for other resources or invalid numbers.
tasks.control_patch:
def product_id_from_gid(gid):
    prefix='gid://shopify/Product/'
    value=gid[len(prefix):] if gid.startswith(prefix) else ''
    return int(value) if value.isdigit() else None

tasks.goal: Implement metadata_boolean(value). Parse a plugin string option: true, yes and 1 (case insensitive and stripped) mean True; everything else False.
tasks.acceptance: assert metadata_boolean(' YES ') is True and metadata_boolean('off') is False
tasks.control_patch:
def metadata_boolean(value):
    return value.strip().lower() in {'true','yes','1'}

tasks.goal: Implement safe_json_object(text). Parse JSON and return its dictionary; malformed JSON or other JSON types return an empty dictionary.
Implement quote_csv_cell(text). Always surround a CSV string cell with double quotes and escape internal double quotes by doubling them.
tasks.control_patch:
def quote_csv_cell(text):
    return '"'+text.replace('"','""')+'"'

tasks.goal: Implement dedupe_webhooks(ids). Remove duplicate webhook event IDs while retaining first-seen order.
tasks.control_patch:
def dedupe_webhooks(ids):
    return list(dict.fromkeys(ids))

tasks.goal: Implement merge_preferences(base,override). Merge settings with override taking precedence without mutating either input mapping.
tasks.control_patch:
def merge_preferences(base,override):
    return {**base,**override}

tasks.goal: Implement parse_env_line(line). Parse one KEY=VALUE string to a tuple, strip both sides, preserve equals in the value. Blank/comment/no-equals lines return None.
tasks.acceptance: assert parse_env_line(' A = x=y ')==('A','x=y') and parse_env_line('# note') is None and parse_env_line('oops') is None

tasks.goal: Implement markdown_title(text). Return the first level-one Markdown heading without its # prefix and surrounding spaces, or None.
tasks.acceptance: assert markdown_title('intro\n# Title\n## Small')=='Title' and markdown_title('## Small') is None
tasks.control_patch:
def markdown_title(text):
    return next((line[2:].strip() for line in text.splitlines() if line.startswith('# ')),None)

tasks.goal: Implement batch_records(items,size). Partition records into lists of at most size elements. Raise ValueError when size is below one.
Implement safe_filename(name). Replace runs outside ASCII letters/digits/underscore/dot/hyphen with underscore, remove leading dots, use untitled if empty.
